fields.build: strict recipe: add Gtk4.Forms.Wpf PackageReference, build (converts, exit 10), build again; pass = "Build succeeded" and "0 Error(s)" in the final log; not-built = legacy non-SDK csproj or native project
fields.run: runs = alive with a visible top-level window (about 10 s smoke run, Windows); crash = unhandled exception or exit before a window; hang = alive, no window; skipped = library; not-run = did not build
fields.windowsOnly: verified classification carried over from the earlier runs (WinForms, Win32/HWND interop, UIA client, COM/ActiveX, WinRT, System.Speech, OLE DB, per-monitor DPI by design, native C++)
fields.errorCodes: distinct error codes of the final build log, re-parsed uniformly for all six batches
fields.missingMembers: CS1061/CS0117 members on layer types, and CS0103 names; members on the sample's own x:Class root types are generator artefacts and are under xamlErrors
fields.xamlErrors: errors caused by the markup compiler: members on a generated root that lacks its base type, internal AttachElementTriggers, CS0029 value conversion and CS0123 delegate types in generated code, attached routed-event syntax, x:Name collisions (CS0102/CS0111/CS0260/CS0262), XAML parse errors
fields.blockerThemes: coarse regex classification of the final-build errors, used for the Next rounds ranking; a ranking aid, not an exact partition
fields.previous: the same project in report 3deb4dba (main db9526db); null when the project was not counted then
fields.unblockedBy: the Round 44 change that removed the 3deb4dba blocker
